scope: AVI video to Theora OGV feasibility and speed preset selection

source.benchmarkInput: The source was looped and bounded to 60 seconds; only video was encoded.

nativeFeasibility.selectionReason: It was 29.20% faster than level 0 and 21.80% faster than level 1 while producing genuine 640x360, 24 fps, 60-second Theora OGV output.

candidateArchitecture.audioPolicy: The initial candidate explicitly excludes AVI audio; audio preservation or Vorbis re-encoding needs separate evidence.

buildAttempts.reason: The specialist source-rewrite preflight stripped only WITHIN_OGV_COPY blocks, so the historical direct-core reverse patch could not match interleaved WITHIN_THEORA_ENCODE blocks.
buildAttempts.correction: The same bounded source rewriter now strips both general-core-only macro families before reconstructing historical specialists.

acceptanceStillRequired: No-Docker hosted Wasm compilation and independent artifact inspection
Production Chromium genuine conversion and full decode validation
Three repeated OPFS and direct-destination runs
Complete Chromium process-tree incremental private memory at or below 250 MiB
Bounded reads, writes, queueing, pending operations, Wasm memory, cancellation, write-failure, and cleanup
Quality comparison and user-visible exclusion review
